description: This file contains shell script functions related to platform-specific hardware upgrade procedures for the OpenWrt router firmware, including functions for image verification and upgrade execution.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the firmware image; currently always returns success (0).

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the platform-specific upgrade; defaults to the 'default_do_upgrade' function unless a specific board name is matched.
